change: QUIC noise payload bytes per second with small-frame pacing; WS/WSS retains burst semantics

rate_sample.scope: One short local race-instrumented correctness sample per mode; not a production throughput guarantee. Both directions additionally checked against 100ms window caps.

semantics.size_options: noise-min-bytes/noise-max-bytes: QUIC payload bytes per second per tunnel and direction; WS bytes per burst
semantics.interval_options: QUIC target-rate refresh hold period, minimum 1 second; all zero disables noise
semantics.scope: payload rate; additional protocol, encryption and network retransmission overhead; independent tunnels add together

deployment: Source change only. Rebuild, install and restart both endpoints; existing production settings were not modified.
